posts.trend: Dreaming of a Germany job? Indian engineer explains what a €70,000 salary looks like after taxes, rent & other costs
posts.context: The LinkedIn fantasy of migrating abroad misses the reality of a global middle-class grind under heavy tax regimes.
posts.angle: Escaping India just changes the currency of your anxiety.
slides: The exact invoice for escaping to Europe.

You survived the Indian middle class.

posts.caption: The grass is green, but it has a high maintenance cost. ✈️
posts.rank_verdict: The final line slightly over-explains the joke by explicitly stating the irony of counting pennies in Euros.
